_comment: English strings for the zuiddrecht-boards demo seed, loaded by occ launchpad:demo:load --lang=en.
Each key is a Dutch string of zuiddrecht-boards.json and its value replaces that string wherever it is a whole text value.
Identifiers, links, filters and data values are never translated (DemoSeedTranslation::KEEP_KEYS). Person names, addresses and the municipality name stay as they are.

strings.**Nieuwe werkwijze Woo-verzoeken vanaf 1:
**New way of handling Open Government Act requests from 1 November**

From 1 November, register every Open Government Act request in dossiq, also when it comes in at the desk or by phone. The Information team will help you get started.

Please confirm by Friday 9 October that you have read this.

strings.**Flexplekken**\n\n- Reserveer een plek:
**Flexible desks**

- Book a desk through the Workplace app, by the evening before at the latest.
- A quiet desk on the 3rd floor is only for focused work.
- Leave the desk empty at 17:30.

**Building opening hours**

| Day | Open | Reception |
|---|---|---|
| Monday to Thursday | 07:00 to 19:00 | 08:00 to 17:30 |
| Friday | 07:00 to 17:00 | 08:00 to 16:00 |
| Saturday | 09:00 to 12:00, Civil affairs only | |
